_note: TerraNexus 6-class geological crosswalk. Built from USGS map group names (Fortezzo 2020, Tanaka 2014) and literature. Confidence: low-moderate (draft). Must be verified against full unit descriptions before production use.

classes.label: Cave / lava tube
classes.note: Added for the brief, which names caves among the terrains to screen. Lunar and martian tube interiors are not mapped at this resolution, so the target-side groups describe the roof material rather than the void itself; treat any match as a surface proxy.

earth_atacama_s24w069.description: Hyper-arid high plateau with ignimbrite volcanic plateau, alluvial fans, and salt flats (salares). Atacama: Rech et al. 2010; Evenstar et al. 2017.

moon_south_pole_lola.description: Lunar South Pole region dominated by ancient highland anorthosite, overlaid by extensive impact basin ejecta and permanently shadowed crater floors. USGS Unified Geologic Map of the Moon (Fortezzo et al. 2020).

mars_jezero_mola.description: Jezero Crater: ancient lacustrine delta deposit in a Noachian impact basin. Surrounded by highland volcanic basalt. USGS Geologic Map of Mars (Tanaka et al. 2014); Farley et al. 2022 (Perseverance).

validation.method: Each class maps USGS map-group names (Fortezzo 2020 for the Moon, Tanaka 2014 for Mars) onto Earth terrain types. The mapping is a literature judgement, not a measurement.
checked: Class names and group spellings match the USGS legend entries cited above.
Every Earth type in this file appears in at least one catalogued site or candidate.
outstanding: No unit description has been read in full against its Earth counterpart, which is what "verified" would mean.
Three classes (impact_related, fluvial, cave) have no independent reviewer.
validation.owner: Unassigned — needs a geologist or planetary scientist to sign off each class.
